laceDeploy.notes: A deploy tx was built and proven by the local proof server, and `yarn fund:wallet` got DUST to the Lace wallet. This predates the move of deploy/join/forget into `hooks/use-deployment.ts` and `components/deployment-card.tsx`; re-run it before calling that verified. The moved `yarn fund:wallet` (packages/fast-sync, one sponsor per wallet) was run twice against a throwaway seed wallet, not Lace: the wallet received 1,000 NIGHT and accruing DUST, and the rerun took the "already sponsored" path.
